User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Course Central system, either a student or a teacher.

name.description: The full name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

role.description: The role of the user (student or teacher).

Course.title: Course
Course.description: Represents a course offered in the Learning Management System.

description.description: A brief description of the course.

duration.description: The duration of the course (e.g., '8 weeks').

teacherId.description: Reference to the User (Teacher) who created the course.

imageId.description: Reference to the placeholder image for the course.

Enrollment.title: Enrollment
Enrollment.description: Represents the enrollment of a student in a course.

id.description: Unique identifier for the enrollment record.

studentId.description: Reference to the User (Student) enrolled in the course.

courseId.description: Reference to the Course the student is enrolled in.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Access is restricted to the user themselves.
Stores all course information. Publicly readable, but only teachers can create them.
Tracks course enrollments for each user. Authorization relies on the userId path segment, ensuring a user can only access their own enrollments.
